summary: Melphalan carries the United States Food and Drug Administration's strongest warning for damage to the immune system and blood cells, which can cause severe bone marrow slowing leading to infection or bleeding [3][7]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this medicine low risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M]. The official label also warns that the injectable form can cause nearby tissue damage if the liquid leaks from a vein during treatment [7].
